body:
Tonight was the first time I bought or used ecstasy and I was expecting some crazy shit.  I brought some glow sticks and went to a friends house with a bottle of water.  I put it in my mouth and chewed it up and swallowed it.  I took it at approximately 9:00 o clock.  The effects were slim to none the whole night, a little bit of twitching, but thats about it.  Maybe they were bad pills?  Im not completely sure though bc a couple of my drug buddies said they were good.  Ive done acid twice (best drug out there btw), smoked the herb and been drunk and I think this has been the least fun of my experiences.
